text:
Situation: Potassium chloride injection products are low across Corvale sites. Corvale East holds 120 units of 14.9 g/100 mL (8.9 days), 35 units of 29.8 g/1000 mL 50 mL bag (2.7 days), and 270 tablets of 750 mg (22 days). Corvale General shows multiple lots ranging from 9.7 to 19.6 days. Corvale Lakeside has 74 units of 14.9 g/100 mL (19.2 days) and 13 units of 750 mg tablets (6.1 days). No other potassium chloride injection forms are listed.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists potassium chloride as "To Be Discontinued" with a status date of 2019-06-10.

Our position: Supply is constrained for injection presentations, especially the 50 mL bag at East. Oral tablets are adequate at East and General but low at Lakeside. Alternative potassium salts (acetate, phosphate) are stocked at all sites.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with A-S Medication Solutions, Advagen Pharma Limited, Affordable Pharmaceuticals LLC, Ajenat Pharmaceuticals LLC, and American Health Packaging for potassium chloride injection; P&T Committee to approve formulary addition if new NDCs differ.
2. Buyer to allocate existing injection stock to highest-acuity areas; Pharmacy Director to approve redistribution plan.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand; Pharmacy Director to receive weekly report.

Not recommended: Initiate clinical protocol changes or dosing substitutions; those are clinical decisions for the treating clinicians and the committee.
